overview: Two 1940 cross-references on Japan funding trips to Japan by Brazilian students.

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a diplomatic despatch on a planned visit of Brazilian students from the Grêmio Cultural Brasileiro-Nippônico to Japan as guests of the Japanese Government.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Brazilian student caravan to Japan as government guests.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 2431 regarding Visit of Brazilian Students to Japan

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a diplomatic report on a prospective trip to Japan by twenty University of São Paulo graduates under the Liga Estudantina Nippo-Brasileira.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: twenty São Paulo graduates to visit Japan at Japan's expense.
subfiles.title: Cross-Reference Sheet for Despatch No. 2660 regarding University of São Paulo Graduates' Trip to Japan
